dhp334:1: For a person who lives negligently,
dhp334:3: they drift from life to life,
dhp334:4: like a monkey in the forest wishing for fruit.
dhp335:1: When one is overcome by that which is despicable -
dhp335:2: craving, which keeps us stuck in the world -
dhp336:1: When one overcomes that which is despicable -
dhp336:2: craving, which is so hard to transcend in this world -
dhp336:3: then sorrow falls away from them,
dhp336:4: like drops of water from a lotus.
